Name: Less Obstructed Forest Farm
Author: Furufoo
Description:
This is my first mod, it is essentially an updated version of [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2826]Forest Farm with Less Lakes [/url]﻿by hazel214, since that one was made way back in 2018.

The aim of this mod is to remove the two leftmost lakes in the forest farm map (The big one in the center and the one close to the path to Marnie's ranch) freeing up a lot of planting space to mess around with!

Works both with new farms and pre-existing farms! Obviously uninstalling this mod while you have stuff built where the lakes would be is probably gonna look weird as hell

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Note[/size]
[list]
[*]Again, baby's first mod. No clue if this will work for you, it worked fine for me, the method I used probably means it'll work for you too. Feel free to tell me if you found any problems
[/list]

Manifest.Description: Small convenient changes to the usual forest farm layout.
